title: How to Cancel Slack — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel or downgrade your Slack paid plan. Switch from Pro/Business+ to Free without losing your messages. Admin steps included.
intro: Only Workspace Owners or Admins can cancel a Slack paid plan. Canceling downgrades your workspace to the free tier — you keep your messages but lose access to older history beyond 90 days.

steps.title: Go to Slack Billing settings
steps.text: Open your Slack workspace in a browser. Click your workspace name → Settings & administration → Workspace settings → Billing.
steps.tip: You must be a Workspace Owner or Admin to access billing settings.

steps.title: Click "Manage plan" or navigate to subscription
steps.text: In the Billing page, find your current plan (Pro or Business+) and click "Manage plan" or "Change plan".

steps.title: Select "Switch to Free" or "Cancel plan"
steps.text: Choose to downgrade to the Free plan. Slack will show you what you'll lose (message history beyond 90 days, unlimited apps, guest access, etc.).
steps.tip: Export your workspace data first (Settings → Import/Export Data) if you need full message history. The export includes everything.

steps.title: Confirm the downgrade
steps.text: Confirm your choice. The paid features remain active until the end of your billing period. After that, your workspace switches to the Free tier.
steps.tip: On the free plan, messages older than 90 days are hidden (not deleted). If you upgrade again later, they reappear.

warnings: Only Workspace Owners/Admins can cancel. Regular members cannot self-cancel.
Free tier limits: 90-day message history, 10 app integrations, no guest access, 1:1 video calls only (no group).
Messages older than 90 days are hidden, not deleted. They come back if you re-upgrade.
If you need an export of all messages for records, do this BEFORE downgrading.
Per-user billing means you may owe for the full billing period even if users leave mid-cycle.

faqs.q: Will I lose my Slack messages if I cancel?
faqs.a: Messages are hidden (not deleted) on the free plan — only the last 90 days are visible. Upgrading again restores full history. You can also export all data before downgrading.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Slack?
faqs.a: Slack prorates refunds for unused time on annual plans. Contact Slack support or check billing settings for credit balance. Monthly plans don't get partial refunds.

faqs.q: What happens to my Slack integrations?
faqs.a: Free tier allows up to 10 app integrations. If you have more, they'll be disabled (not deleted). You choose which 10 to keep active.

faqs.q: Can a regular member cancel Slack?
faqs.a: No. Only Workspace Owners and Admins can manage billing and cancel/downgrade the plan. Contact your workspace admin.

refund.details: Slack offers prorated credits for unused time on annual plans. These credits can be applied to future charges or refunded. Monthly plans are not refunded for partial periods.

retentionTactics: Slack shows you exactly how much message history will become hidden.
They highlight the number of integrations that will be disabled.
They may offer a discount or suggest reducing seats instead of downgrading entirely.
